idea: Online course: how to break into equity research
buyer: Graduates and career changers targeting research roles
pain: The path in is opaque and university careers services are useless
v1: A recorded course with CV and interview modules
verdict: Good leverage but a crowded market selling to buyers with no money, from zero audience.

why.distribution: Students are not her network and reaching them means building an audience from zero.
why.demand: Career courses do sell; the finance careers space is well served already.
why.fmf: She has done the job and hired into it - genuinely authoritative.
why.revenue_structure: One-off purchases with no repeat; each cohort must be found again.
why.defensibility: Finance career content is abundant and heavily discounted.
why.tailwind: Adverse - research headcount is shrinking, so the jobs she teaches people to get are disappearing.
why.ceiling: £450 x 440 students = £198k, needing a large audience she does not have.

ceiling_arithmetic: £450 x 440 students = £198k. Reaching 440 paying students needs a substantial audience built from nothing in a crowded category. Realistic: 40-80 = £18-36k.
carries: Real authority and full media leverage.
kills: Selling to students with no money, from zero distribution, into a shrinking profession.
test: Post three substantial careers pieces and count enquiries.
test_pass: People ask to pay for more.
